title: School Safety Violation Classification Policy (illustrative)
note: Illustrative policy authored for this project from the safeguarding categories and research gaps identified in the stage-1 literature review. Not a legal document.

clauses.title: Student-on-student physical altercation
indicators: two or more persons in sustained close contact
rapid limb extension consistent with striking
high motion variance localized to a small region
clauses.response: Notify duty administrator; nearest staff member attends within 60 seconds.

clauses.title: Weapon or weapon-like object present
indicators: detector reports knife, firearm or weapon-like object with confidence above threshold
object held or brandished rather than carried in a bag
clauses.response: Immediate emergency escalation; lockdown procedure per school protocol.

clauses.title: Adult-on-child physical coercion
indicators: marked height or bounding-box scale disparity between the interacting persons
one person restraining, pulling or striking a markedly smaller person
the smaller person withdrawing or being moved against their motion direction
clauses.response: Immediate safeguarding escalation; preserve footage under child-protection retention rules.

clauses.title: Repeated targeting without physical contact
indicators: a group persistently surrounding one isolated individual
low physical contact but sustained encirclement
the isolated individual repeatedly attempting to exit the cluster
clauses.response: Notify class teacher and pastoral lead for follow-up; no emergency response.

clauses.title: Rough play, sport or celebration (no violation)
indicators: high motion with mutual, reciprocal engagement
no asymmetry of advantage between participants
context is a sports area, break period or organized activity
clauses.response: Log only. Suppress alert. This is the dominant false-positive class in the reviewed literature.

privacy_rules.rule: Faces in any frame retained or transmitted must be blurred before the frame leaves the detection pipeline.
privacy_rules.rationale: Only 2 of the 50 reviewed studies addressed privacy at all; continuous monitoring of minors demands redaction by default.

privacy_rules.rule: Reasoning stages that use an external LLM receive aggregated numeric features and text only, never frames or crops.
privacy_rules.rationale: Keeps identifiable imagery inside the local pipeline.

privacy_rules.rule: Reports carry no names or identifiers, only camera id, timestamp and track numbers.
privacy_rules.rationale: An alert should be actionable without pre-judging who is involved.
